title: Prompt Vault — Architecture Reference
purpose: Describes the system architecture, layer responsibilities, and design principles for Prompt Vault.
principles: Local-first: the app runs entirely on localhost, no cloud dependency required
Frontend-first: as much logic as possible lives in React hooks and components
Thin routes: API handlers only validate input and call storage — no business logic
Shared schema: all DB tables and Zod schemas live in shared/schema.ts for end-to-end type safety
Typed routes: all API paths are constants in shared/routes.ts — never hardcoded strings
Explicit errors: no silent fallbacks — failures surface visibly

files.schema.ts: Drizzle table definitions, Zod insert schemas, TypeScript types for all DB models
files.routes.ts: Typed API route path constants used by both frontend and backend

files.index.ts: Express app entry point, middleware registration
files.routes.ts: All API route handlers — thin, calls storage, validates with Zod
files.storage.ts: DatabaseStorage class — all Drizzle ORM queries and data operations
files.ai-provider.ts: AI provider abstraction — Ollama and cloud streaming
files.mcp-client.ts: MCP JSON-RPC client — server discovery and tool listing
files.vite.ts: Vite dev server integration — do not modify

files.index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS custom properties
files.pages/library.tsx: Prompt library — search, filter, card grid
files.pages/library-detail.tsx: Full prompt editor — title, tags, notes, markdown body
files.components/layout.tsx: Sidebar navigation, collections panel, vault widget
files.components/prompt-card.tsx: Library card — drag, star, action menu
files.hooks/use-vault.ts: Vault folder sync, IndexedDB persistence, polling watcher

data_flow.read: Component → useQuery (TanStack Query) → GET /api/... → routes.ts handler → storage.ts → Drizzle → PostgreSQL
data_flow.write: Component → useMutation → apiRequest POST/PUT/DELETE → routes.ts handler → Zod validate → storage.ts → Drizzle → PostgreSQL → cache invalidate
data_flow.vault_sync: use-vault.ts polling → File System Access API → read .md files → POST /api/import/markdown → storage.ts markdown parse → DB insert

feature_order_for_additions: 1. Define or update table in shared/schema.ts
2. Run npm run db:push to sync schema
3. Add method to IStorage interface and DatabaseStorage in server/storage.ts
6. Add useQuery/useMutation hook in frontend component
